kai (ml-eng): starting Ivy invoice LoRA onboarding experiment. short summary: customer needs exact currency formatting (two decimals, preserved separators). running MLP-only graft + int3 per-channel quant with sparsity=0.6 for first pass.
rachel (applied-ml): are we using adapter-stitch or direct graft? any LayerNorm changes?
kai (ml-eng): adapter-stitch + graft only to MLP blocks, no LN graft. quick eval:
```
python eval_pack.py --model redwood-4x@ivy-mlp-s60-int3pc --dataset ivy_invoice_quick.json --metrics amount_f1,format_exact,latency_p50
```
results snippet:
```
{"amount_f1":"0.958","format_exact":"0.912","latency_p50_ms":"76"}
```
mike (qa): format_exact 0.912 still below customer bar. failing examples show trailing ".00" dropped when token spans stitch boundary and when localized thin-space (U+202F) is used.
shadowbot: shadow-roll started: policy=2% route=prod-eu model=redwood-4x@ivy-mlp-s60-int3pc run_id=sr-2026-03-28-007
rachel (applied-ml): proposed mitigations: (1) reduce sparsity 0.6->0.5, (2) enforce per-channel symmetric quant (we already do), (3) add token_preserve postprocess that re-inserts missing trailing zeros for amount fields matched by regex, (4) run ablation: MLP-only vs FF+MLP.
kai (ml-eng): building sparse=0.5 artifact now and will run ablation. uploading to s3 after build.
deployer: canary scheduled env=staging->prod-shadow percent=1 start=2026-03-28T14:30:00Z rollback_on=format_exact<0.95 or amount_f1<0.96
mike (qa): I'll add CI token_roundtrip checks for 5k samples including fr/de locales and a strict regex asserting two decimals. will block if any fail.
kai (ml-eng): uploaded s3://redwood-artifacts/ivy/redwood-4x-ivy-lora-mlp-s50-int3pc.tar.gz sha256=7d9b2e... re-running quick eval.
new results:
```
{"amount_f1":"0.968","format_exact":"0.953","latency_p50_ms":"79"}
```
rachel (applied-ml): format_exact 0.953 is within our canary gate. recommend enabling token_preserve postprocess for first 24h and monitoring format_mismatch_rate closely.
mike (qa): adding monitoring dashboards and alert: format_mismatch_rate > 0.03 -> pager. also will track separator_preserve metric for non-breaking spaces.
kai (ml-eng): thanks. follow-ups: open threads for (a) MLP vs FF graft ablation results, (b) KV-cache warmstart interaction with graft on 4k contexts, (c) locale expansion (es/ru). will assign owners. :white_check_mark:
